{{Quote|That was an Express-class ''[sic]'' ambassadorial shuttle and it had the markings of the Royal House of Hapes.|[[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], after seeing the ''Thunder Wraith'' lift off|<ref name="Lightsabers" />}}
The '''''Express''-class ambassadorial shuttle''' was a small, sleek [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] about half the size of a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]]. As an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadorial]] shuttle, it had spacious passenger compartments with ornate [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreens]] offering a 360-degree view of the outside surroundings. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], the [[Hapan]]-[[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]] [[Tenel Ka Djo|Tenel Ka]] was transported to [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]] on an ''Express'' shuttle known as the ''[[Thunder Wraith]]'' following a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] training accident at the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on the [[Tree/Legends|jungle]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] in which the lower part of her left [[Limb/Legends|arm]] was severed.<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The shuttle class appeared in ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', a young reader's book published in [[1998]] and written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />
